capabilities: replace all matches found by the core search
enter a replacement string in the search input box
undo the previous replace-all via a command palette command
extras: README mentions installing via Settings > Community plugins or by manually placing files in the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: injects replace all functionality directly into the core file plugin
problem: Obsidian's core search finds text but offers no way to replace every instance across files in one action.
summary: Replace-all utility that adds find-and-replace-all into Obsidian's core search, with an undo command.
